blocks.text: Training specialists with humanitarian and socio-economic education who meet the national interests of the country and are competitive in the modern labor market
Principles of BSU activities:• Dynamic development• International recognition• Flexibility• Availability• Demand in the labor market

Priority areas of BSU:• Improving the quality of education• Modernization of the content of secondary and higher education programs• Implementation of modern educational technologies• Intensification of research activities• Development of academic mobility of teachers and students• Integration into the global educational space
Re-approved at the Academic Council, protocol No. 3 of December 1, 2023
